description: Attention seeds. Attention entries live in vector space: when an incoming message is close enough to one of these topics, the agent may speak without a probability roll. Keep them few and concrete — a dozen well-chosen topics beat a hundred vague ones.

attention.label: an ongoing project the owner is actively shipping
a commitment the owner made and has not closed
a recurring personal goal the owner tracks (training, study, health)
a decision the owner is still weighing and may want a second opinion on
